name: Leave native defaults alone
summary: Setup leaves the agent's own defaults alone: effort, auto memory, MCP tool search, idle compaction, cache TTLs and permission mode, because overriding them costs cache hits or quality. Lower effort is a reference arm in every bench, never a silent default change.

evidence.source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22732 (TokenEconomizer: Experience-Driven Black-Box Cost Control for Coding Agents)
evidence.setting: Vendor-run; medium effort as a reference arm, Claude Code 2.1.170; the effort figures come from the paper's tables and weren't re-read
evidence.effect: Medium effort alone cut cost 16.8 to 28.9% at a 1.8 to 4.7-point pass-rate loss

evidence.setting: Documentation; supports leaving cache TTLs alone
evidence.effect: A one-hour cache for the main conversation and five minutes for everything else

revisit: a user's own bench shows lower effort non-inferior at lower cost: offer it as a personal setting
maintenance: Owned engine behavior; re-check the list of defaults on new agent versions.
